# Every default binding

<!-- Generated by `ase --dump-docs`. Do not edit: your changes will be
     overwritten the next time the docs are built. -->

The built-in table in full. Any row can be replaced in your config — see
[Keybindings](../guide/keybindings.md) for how, and for why the layers are
shaped this way.

`Mode` is `any` unless the row only applies in one Vim mode.

## Ctrl

Brought from other editors and the OS, plus Vim's own Ctrl chords.

| Keys | Command | Mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ctrl+S | `editor.save` | any |
| Ctrl+Shift+S | `editor.save-as` | any |
| Ctrl+P | `editor.open-in-project` | any |
| Ctrl+N | `buffer.new` | any |
| Ctrl+Tab | `buffer.next` | any |
| Ctrl+Shift+Tab | `buffer.previous` | any |
| Ctrl+Q | `editor.quit` | any |
| Ctrl+F | `editor.find` | any |
| Ctrl+H | `editor.replace` | any |
| Ctrl+C | `editor.copy` | any |
| Ctrl+X | `editor.cut` | any |
| Ctrl+V | `editor.paste` | any |
| Ctrl+A | `editor.select-all` | any |
| Ctrl+Z | `editor.undo` | any |
| Ctrl+Shift+Z | `editor.redo` | any |
| Ctrl+D | `editor.cursor.add-next-occurrence` | any |
| Ctrl+= | `editor.font.larger` | any |
| Ctrl++ | `editor.font.larger` | any |
| Ctrl+- | `editor.font.smaller` | any |
| Ctrl+0 | `editor.font.reset` | any |
| Ctrl+O | `editor.jump-back` | any |
| Ctrl+I | `editor.jump-forward` | any |
| Ctrl+D | `vim.half-page-down` | normal |
| Ctrl+U | `vim.half-page-up` | normal |
| Ctrl+D | `vim.half-page-down` | visual |
| Ctrl+U | `vim.half-page-up` | visual |
| Ctrl+A | `vim.number.increment` | normal |
| Ctrl+X | `vim.number.decrement` | normal |
| Ctrl+R | `editor.redo` | normal |
| Ctrl+R | `editor.redo` | insert |
| Ctrl+R | `editor.redo` | visual |

## Ctrl+W

Structure: regions, their focus, size and life. Vim's window prefix.

| Keys | Command | Mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ctrl+W then J | `pane.focus-down` | any |
| Ctrl+W then K | `pane.focus-up` | any |
| Ctrl+W then W | `pane.cycle` | any |
| Ctrl+W then C | `pane.close` | any |
| Ctrl+W then Q | `pane.close` | any |
| Ctrl+W then O | `pane.only` | any |
| Ctrl+W then + | `editor.output-panel.taller` | any |
| Ctrl+W then = | `editor.output-panel.taller` | any |
| Ctrl+W then - | `editor.output-panel.shorter` | any |
| Ctrl+W then N | `buffer.new` | any |

## Alt

This editor's own, where there is no convention to inherit.

| Keys | Command | Mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Alt+O | `editor.open` | any |
| Alt+I | `editor.about` | any |
| Alt+F | `editor.find-in-project` | any |
| Alt+R | `editor.replace-in-project` | any |
| Alt+S | `editor.document-symbols` | any |
| Alt+B | `editor.compile` | any |
| Alt+P | `editor.output-panel` | any |
| Alt+; | `editor.command-line` | any |
| Alt+Left | `editor.jump-back` | any |
| Alt+Right | `editor.jump-forward` | any |

## Function keys

Ask the language server.

| Keys | Command | Mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | `editor.help` | any |
| F12 | `editor.go-to-definition` | any |
| Shift+F12 | `editor.find-references` | any |
| F2 | `editor.rename-symbol` | any |
